answer: Bonded identity registry: every agent key must lock a slashable stake plus a verifiable proof-of-work beacon binding key to real cost. Each identity needs its own bond and its own beacon, so a Sybil farm pays linearly per clone while payout per clone stays flat. A vertex of trust, meaning the audit graph's highest-weight node, anchors collateral checks: one upheld fraud report voids the whole linked component. The trust harbor only fills from bonds surviving audit, so mass fabrication is a losing trade.
